name: Hana no Kioku Dai 5 Shou
source:
Collection of five short erotic stories.

1. Office lady find satisfaction on a date or right at the workplace.
2. Tour guide finds several different opportunities for sex on a trip
3. Girl conducts a survey through different flats, and some inhabitants get very excited
4. Kendo club girl either gets assaulted at school or gets into gentle relations at home
5. School nurse harasses a girl during health check or enjoys fantasies

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
由五篇色情短篇组成的合集。

1．女职员可以在约会或工作场所中寻求满足。
2．导游会在旅途中遇到数次性爱机会。
3．少女挨家挨户进行问卷调查，部分住户因此兴奋不已。
4．剑道部少女可能在学校遭到侵犯，也可能在家中发展出温柔的关系。
5．校医可以在体检时骚扰少女，或沉浸于自己的幻想。
